story_description: As a developer, I need a Swift adapter that communicates with the Codex app-server via bidirectional stdio JSON-RPC so that Blaze can send prompts and receive streaming responses without HTTP transport.
task_description: Extend NormalizedEvent enum with Codex-specific variants that map from Codex's unique streaming events (turn/plan/updated, account/rateLimits/updated, item/reasoning, item/commandExecution/outputDelta, item/fileChange/outputDelta) to enable full-fidelity rendering of Codex sessions.
atom_description: Add five new NormalizedEvent cases: TurnPlanUpdated (from turn/plan/updated with turnId, explanation, steps array), RateLimitsUpdated (from account/rateLimits/updated with primary/secondary RateLimit), ReasoningDelta (from item/reasoning/* with summaryDelta/contentDelta), ToolOutputDelta (from item/commandExecution/outputDelta), and FileDiffDelta (from item/fileChange/outputDelta). Each case includes associated data structs with proper Codable/Sendable conformance.
problem_statement: Codex CLI emits structured streaming events that have no equivalent in the current NormalizedEvent enum. Events like turn/plan/updated (showing multi-step execution plans), account/rateLimits/updated (quota tracking), item/reasoning/* (extended thinking), and incremental output deltas for commands and file changes cannot be represented with existing cases. Without these extensions, Blaze will either drop Codex-specific data or force it into ill-fitting generic containers, degrading the user experience.

edge_cases: Empty steps array in TurnPlanUpdatedEvent - valid for plan initialization before steps added
Both summaryDelta and contentDelta nil in ReasoningDeltaEvent - valid for event structure updates without content
Both primary and secondary nil in RateLimitsUpdatedEvent - represents rate limits cleared or unavailable
Empty delta string in ToolOutputDelta/FileDiffDelta - valid for heartbeat or progress indication
Very long delta strings exceeding 1MB - should be handled by consumers with truncation
failure_modes: Invalid JSON during Codable decode - throws DecodingError; mitigation: adapter catches and logs, emits RawEvent fallback
Unknown PlanStepStatus rawValue - throws DecodingError; mitigation: add unknown case with associated String for forward compat
Timestamp parsing failure - throws DecodingError; mitigation: use ISO8601DateFormatter with fallback to epoch
rollback_plan: Revert changes to NormalizedEvent.swift restoring previous version without Codex cases. Delete NormalizedEventExtensionsTests.swift. CodexCliAdapter will fall back to emitting RawEvent for unmapped Codex events. No database migration required.
